dataset: MVTec-AD, 15 categories, 5.03 GB, from huggingface micguida1/mvtech_anomaly_detection, extracted to /mnt/d/mvtec
protocol: 20 normal training images per category, 256x256, ResNet-18 layer1/2/3 concatenated, 100 channels, per-position diagonal Gaussian, score = 99th percentile of the position map
reference: PaDiM paper reports ~97.5% mean image AUROC with all training images and a full covariance
what_changed: one thing: the features come from an ImageNet-trained ResNet-18 instead of random kernels. Same per-position Gaussian, same training count, same metric.
failures_that_survive: screw 51.8%: below any usable threshold despite the pretrained backbone. Resolution (256 vs 384) and five aggregation statistics were tried; scripts/diag_padim_screw.py and diag_padim_agg.py reproduce both.
grid 68.3% and pill 59.0%: textures and small objects with low-contrast defects
caveat: 8 of 15 categories run, not all of them; the mean is over these 8 and should not be quoted as 'MVTec-AD performance'.
